paragraphs.text: The Pocket Players' Guide for Magic: The Gathering - Fourth Edition is a guide to the cards and rules of the Fourth Edition of Magic . It was published in 1995 .
Introduction by Rich Redman and Eric Doohan
The World of Dominia Notes From the Designer - by Richard Garfield Nature of Dominia - by John Tynes

Developing Your Deck Excuse Me, Mr. Suitcase? - by Paul Peterson It's in the Cards: An Examination of Card Combinations - by Mark Rosewater
Multiplayer Environments Multiplayer Magic - by Jim Lin and Dave Pettey Leagues and Drafts - by Charlie Catino , Joel Mick , Steve Conard and Allen Varney
The Duelists' Convocation and Official Tournament Rules - by The Duelists' Convocation
